description: Modal picker for the shape to connect when the user drags a connect arrow off a node. By default it offers only the node stencils of the source node's own set (declared SetId, else the id family prefix), narrowed by a search box; the 'Show all' toggle opts into the whole node library. Renders a roving arrow-key tile grid on desktop and plain rows with a Close footer button on the mobile bottom sheet. Edge stencils are never offered.
examples:
<TmDiagramConnectDialog Show="_connectOpen"
                         SourceStencilId="_sourceStencilId"
                         OnClose="() => _connectOpen = false"
                         OnStencilSelected="ConnectAs"
                         RestoreFocusTarget="@_canvasRef" />

cssClasses.name: tm-diagram-connect-modal
cssClasses.description: Dialog body column: toolbar, tile grid and the empty-state note.

cssClasses.name: tm-diagram-connect-modal__toolbar
cssClasses.description: One row holding the search field and the Show-all toggle.

cssClasses.name: tm-diagram-connect-modal__search
cssClasses.description: Class of the search TmTextInput (lands on the input element).

cssClasses.name: tm-diagram-connect-modal__show-all
cssClasses.description: Show-all toggle button; aria-pressed mirrors the state.

cssClasses.name: tm-diagram-connect-modal__grid
cssClasses.description: Tile container; a 3-column grid on desktop, single-column rows below 640px.

cssClasses.name: tm-diagram-connect-modal__item
cssClasses.description: One stencil tile; roving tabindex carries the arrow-key tab stop.

cssClasses.name: tm-diagram-connect-modal__label
cssClasses.description: Localized stencil name under (desktop) or beside (mobile) the icon.

cssClasses.name: tm-diagram-connect-modal__close
cssClasses.description: Sheet footer Close button; the whole footer hides at 640px and up.

cssClasses.name: tm-diagram-connect-modal__empty
cssClasses.description: Localized empty-state note when the search matches nothing.

parameters.name: SourceStencilId
parameters.description: Stencil id of the source node. Its set scopes the default palette; unknown or empty ids fall back to every node stencil.

parameters.name: OnStencilSelected
parameters.description: Raised with the picked stencil id; the host creates the node and the edge.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Auto follows the viewport (bottom sheet under 640px); a forced value never measures, so tests can render the sheet without a DOM.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTarget
parameters.description: Element focus returns to when the dialog closes — typically the diagram canvas.
